LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Small: About 24 hubs, three corporations. A tight net: everything is close, the corporations take a bigger share.
LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Normal: About 32 hubs, three corporations, every district including the Campus.
LanguageData.NR_NetSizeTip_Large: About 41 hubs, four corporations, more nodes in every district. The farthest hub is still about 6 hours from Home. Recommended.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsGradualDistrictsTip: At the start only Home and the districts next to it are charted; the rest are faint, with a "?", their branches hidden. A runner stepping in charts a district, and every clean dive charts the next one. Nothing is locked. Off: the whole map is charted from the start.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Outskirts: Weak nodes and little Heat: the place to learn.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Transit: The backbone that links the districts; fast lanes, few nodes.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Market: Shops and exchanges: steady cyberdata, sometimes silver.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Campus: Archives of the academies: research data turns up here.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Entertainment: Studios and clubs: celebrity braindance chips.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Corp: Corporate ground: rich vaults, hard ICE, loud trace.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Dump: Data dumps: junk, but AI fragments wash up here.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Ruins: Dead servers of the old companies: deserted nodes, forgotten caches.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Dark: The dark net: backdoors and people who do not want to be found.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_OldNet: The Old Net behind the Wall: ancient systems, Black ICE 10+.
LanguageData.NR_DistrictHint_Orbit: Orbital backbone: reachable only while the gravship is in orbit.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsMapLayoutTip: How the districts are laid out on new maps. Ring: the transit hubs in a circle in the middle. Spine: a transit line across the map. Archipelago: districts apart, few links between them. Metro: a dense net with many links. Random: picked by the world seed. Changes apply to a new map (dev mode: "Netrun: cyberspace → Map: regenerate...").
LanguageData.NR_SettingsMapSizeTip: Size of the cyberspace map in new games. The game asks again when the colony first enters the net; the layout comes from the world seed.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundIntro: The colony has found its way into the net. Pick how this world's net is laid out and how big it is: both stay for the whole game.
LanguageData.NR_NetLayoutDesc_Ring: Transit hubs in a circle in the middle.
LanguageData.NR_NetLayoutDesc_Spine: One transit line across the whole map.
LanguageData.NR_NetLayoutDesc_Archipelago: Districts stand apart, few links between them.
LanguageData.NR_NetLayoutDesc_Metro: A dense net with many links.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundPrompt: The net has not been mapped yet.
LanguageData.NR_NetFoundNote: The defaults for future games are in the mod settings.
LanguageData.NR_MapConnectTip: The netrunner in the pod connects at Home. Walking the net takes game time: about an hour per link, half that on fast lines.
LanguageData.NR_MapNotReady: The net has not been mapped yet.
LanguageData.NR_MapNoPodPawn: Nobody is lying in a powered cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_MapFirstStep_1: Put a colonist with a neural interface into a cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_MapFirstStep_2: Pick an exit hub on the map and connect the runner there.
LanguageData.NR_MapFirstStep_3: Pick a node in a hub, choose programs and dive.
LanguageData.NR_MapHotkeys:
Hotkeys:
F: search
H: Home
R or Tab: next runner
0: the whole map
WASD: move the map
Esc: clear the selection
LanguageData.NR_MapGoTip: The selected runner walks the shortest route. The game keeps running; a message comes on arrival.
LanguageData.NR_MapExitTip: A clean exit at an exit point or Home: the pod wakes the runner, nothing else.
LanguageData.NR_MapNotAtExit: Only at an exit point or Home.
LanguageData.NR_MapEmergencyTip: Disconnect right now, anywhere: Netsick +{0}, cyberspace nausea, {1} chance of a lockout. Aegis or a Warden AI halve it.
LanguageData.NR_MapEmergencyConfirm: Pull {0} out of the net right now? It hurts.
LanguageData.NR_MapJumpTip: Connect straight at this exit point instead of Home.
LanguageData.NR_MapRouteLost: {0} lost the way: the route broke.
LanguageData.NR_MapTollUnpaid: {0} stopped at a toll link: no cyberdata to pay.
LanguageData.NR_MapPatrolHit: An ICE patrol at {1} caught {0} passing through.
LanguageData.NR_MapBranchOffline: The node is offline right now.
LanguageData.NR_MapNeedRunnerHere: A connected runner has to stand at this hub.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsMaintenance: Planned maintenance around {NODE}: links down for a day.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsTransit: A transit window at {NODE}: links through it are instant.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsToll: A toll goes up on a link at {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsBackdoor: Someone opened a backdoor between {NODE} and {OTHER}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsDarkLink: A tunnel leaked on a forum: a dark link near {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsCableCut: A cable broke at {NODE}; the net rebuilt around it.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsNewNode: The net grows: a new hub, {NODE}.
LanguageData.NR_MapNewsWall: The Wall has a gate now: the Old Net is open.
LanguageData.NR_MapWall: With a corporate core broken, the old gates in the Wall answer for the first time. Beyond them lies the Old Net: ancient systems behind Black ICE 10, with legendary loot.
LanguageData.NR_MapLinkOffline: The hub at this end is offline: no way through for now.
LanguageData.NR_MapWallLocked: The Wall: the way into the Old Net is shut.
LanguageData.NR_MapSearchHint: Find a hub, node or corp… (F)
LanguageData.NR_MapMinimapTip: The whole net. The frame is what you see; click to jump. Keys: H home, R or Tab next runner, 0 whole map, F search.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Overview: Overview: hubs in their district colours; with a runner standing still, where it can step now.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Loot: Loot: the best haul known at each hub.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Danger: Danger: ICE and gates, patrols and fortresses.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Corps: Corps: corporate ground in each corporation's colour.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Contracts: Jobs: contract targets and your watchlist.
LanguageData.NR_MapLensTip_Time: Time: hours of travel from the selected runner.
LanguageData.NR_MapCardClicks: Click: select · double click or Shift: send the runner · Shift on a moving runner: waypoint · right click: menu
LanguageData.NR_MapMenuWaypoint: Add a waypoint (continue from the route's end)
LanguageData.NR_MapPingMoving: The runner is on the move.
LanguageData.NR_MapThreat:
A patrol or an intrusion stands on {0}'s route at {1}. The game is paused: change the route or stop the runner.
Autopause can be turned off in the settings.
LanguageData.NR_MapGoHomeTip: Send the runner back to Home (an exit point: from there it can leave the net).
LanguageData.NR_MapGoAndExitTip: Walk to the nearest exit point and leave the net there, in one action.
LanguageData.NR_Legend_Tip: What the marks on the map mean. Click a row to light every hub it applies to; click it again (or Esc) to let go.
LanguageData.NR_GuardLocked: A protected corporate hub: break its guard gateway (⚿, in a hub next door) first.
LanguageData.NR_GuardBroken: The guard gateway is down: {0} is open for {1}. Its loot is richer than usual.
LanguageData.NR_GuardFailHeat: Failed dive in a protected hub
LanguageData.NR_MapNextRunnerTip: Select the next runner and centre on it (R or Tab).
LanguageData.NR_MapNetsickChipTip: How long a runner can still stay in the net before Netsick turns strong: the shortest time among your runners in pods (or, with nobody in a pod, among the colonists with a cyberlink). Netsick grows with time in the net and fades offline; past "strong" a long dive is a risk.
LanguageData.NR_MapHubOffline: This hub is offline: no way in until it comes back (an orbit uplink opens only while your colony is in orbit).
LanguageData.NR_MapCardGuardShut: Protected corporate hub, locked. Its key is the guard gateway (amber diamond) in {0}: break it in a dive and this hub opens for 3 days with x1.4 loot (the dashed amber line points to it).
LanguageData.NR_MapCardGuardOpen: Protected hub, open for {0}: x1.4 loot; a failed dive here adds 6 Heat.
LanguageData.NR_MapCardGuardKey: Holds the guard gateway of {0}: a clean dive into it opens that hub.
LanguageData.NR_MapCardOrbitClosed: Orbital hub: reachable only while your gravship is in orbit.
LanguageData.NR_MapNowQuiet: Quiet in the net: nothing in effect, nothing on the clock.
LanguageData.NR_MapNowClick: Click: show the hub on the map.
LanguageData.NR_MapKeyTip: Amber diamond: the key. This node is the guard gateway of {0}; a clean dive into it opens that protected hub for 3 days (x1.4 loot).
